name: @pikku/addon-admin
description: Admin addon for Pikku — the user directory, roles and scopes, credentials and the audit trail, as ordinary RPCs

scripts.build: pikku all && tsc && (cp .pikku/rpc/*.d.ts dist/.pikku/rpc/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp .pikku/agent/*.d.ts dist/.pikku/agent/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp .pikku/workflow/*.d.ts dist/.pikku/workflow/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (mkdir -p dist/.pikku/function && cp .pikku/function/*-verbose.gen.json dist/.pikku/function/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (mkdir -p dist/types && cp types/*.d.ts dist/types/)
